task: For each proposed claim, give supported, contradicted, insufficient, or abstain based only on the supplied source fragment. Also extract the requested reported fact, even when the proposed claim is contradicted. Use null when the requested fact is not supplied.
held_out_definition: New questions and fragments selected after existing project prompts and engineered metadata tests were written; not guaranteed unseen in model pretraining. This corpus is now public development material, not a reusable secret test.

scope_vocabulary.VALUE_CHAIN_NET: Entire reported value-chain footprint after reported offsets
scope_vocabulary.VALUE_CHAIN_TOTAL_MARKET: Reported all-scope footprint using market-based Scope 2
scope_vocabulary.VALUE_CHAIN_TOTAL_LOCATION: Reported all-scope footprint using location-based Scope 2
scope_vocabulary.GROUP_CFO: Consolidated Group cash flow from operating activities
scope_vocabulary.GROUP_FCF_NON_GAAP: Consolidated Group non-GAAP free cash flow
scope_vocabulary.SEGMENT_CASH_CAPEX: Named segment non-GAAP cash capital expenditure
scope_vocabulary.OPERATIONAL_S1_S2_TARGET: Operational Scope 1/2 market-based target coverage vs stated baseline
scope_vocabulary.GROUP_S1: Group Scope 1 with stated consolidation boundary
scope_vocabulary.CUSTOMER_SAVED_AVOIDED_CUMULATIVE: Cumulative customer CO2 saved and avoided
scope_vocabulary.ORGANIC_INVESTMENT: Organic issuer investment, excluding separately reported corporate transactions
scope_vocabulary.GROUP_ENERGY_INTENSITY: Group intensity excluding separately reported operationally controlled companies

locator.section: Apple progress toward carbon neutrality; historical emissions table

headers: Million metric tons CO2e per fiscal year
AP-table.source_quote: Totals might not add up due to rounding.
AP-table.context: Historical whole-footprint emissions; the report uses a fiscal-year basis. Selected cells, no forward projection included.

AP-avoided.context: Issuer-estimated avoided emissions across all scopes, distinct from the reported gross footprint. No issuer earnings amount appears in this fragment.

AZ-table.source_quote: Scope 2 and 3 carbon emissions are calculated using a market-based method.
AZ-table.context: The table restates 2022 and 2023 under the updated carbon methodology. It does not supply an emissions-to-earnings attribution.

SH-group.context: Asterisks identify the report non-GAAP measures; cash flow from operating activities is not marked with an asterisk.

locator.section: Liquidity and capital resources — cash capital expenditure split by segment

SH-segment.context: Segment cash capital expenditure is a cash investment measure, not a disclosed incremental carbon-tax saving or investment return.

locator.section: Underlying operating profit and underlying operating margins — Group reconciliation

UL-profit.context: The reconciliation separates statutory operating profit from underlying operating profit.

UL-emissions.context: This is operational Scope 1 and 2 target performance, not all value-chain emissions. Target coverage excludes biogenic fuels and controlled owned/leased vehicles under the stated SBTi minimum scope.

locator.section: Underlying sales growth — reconciliation; Group column

UL-sales.context: The report defines underlying sales growth by excluding specified acquisitions, disposals, currency and extreme hyperinflation price effects. The table does not attribute all sales growth to sustainability.

locator.section: Performance data — Gross scopes 1, 2, 3 and total GHG emissions

MA-emissions.source_quote: Numbers restated due to improved reporting processes.
MA-emissions.context: The report consolidates GHG emissions under financial consolidation; comparative 2023 values carry the restatement footnote. No EBIT saving is disclosed in these selected cells.

SE-score.context: SSI is a composite score on a 0–10 scale, not a percentage of emissions reduction.

rows: Customer emissions saved and avoided; million tonnes CO2
CO2 reduction from top 1,000 supplier operations
SE-climate.context: Footnote 3 applies to the customer saved/avoided emissions. The supplier row covers top 1,000 supplier operations, not Schneider own operating emissions. Dashboard baseline is current-cycle baseline unless a specific footnote says otherwise.

locator.section: Full-Year Results 2024 Highlights — accelerating growth and record investments

IB-investment.context: Original press-release numerical disclosures transcribed as cells. Net profit and investment are distinct measures. Organic and corporate investment are separately disclosed.

locator.section: Strong boost to the social dividend

IB-intensity.source_quote: Emissions of 38 grams of CO2 per kWh in Europe
IB-intensity.context: FY2024 highlights. The release does not disclose a corresponding tax saving amount. The geographic qualifier is Europe.

locator.section: Climate change — Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions

VW-emissions.context: The combined total is printed as 1.1 for market-based Scope 2; independently rounded component values need not sum exactly. Source row boundaries retained.

locator.section: Energy intensity in high climate impact sectors

VW-energy.context: Source definition excludes companies with operational control from this intensity metric and uses Group activities associated with vehicle production. No incremental earnings attribution is disclosed.
